title: Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation and cognitive bias modification in alcohol‑dependent patients after detoxification: a prospective randomized controlled therapy study (StimCogBiasMod SCBM study)
summary: Alcohol use disorders—particularly alcohol dependence—are common and often chronic conditions associated with a high risk of relapse. Existing treatment approaches, such as combined psychotherapeutic and pharmacotherapeutic interventions, are followed by renewed drinking episodes within three months after completion of treatment in up to 70% of affected individuals. There is therefore an urgent need for novel therapeutic approaches. Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) as well as cognitive bias modification (CBM; approach bias modification, ApBM) are promising methods which, as adjuncts to established treatments, may help to improve the prognosis of alcohol dependence. The aim of this study is to administer rTMS and ApBM, separately and in combination, versus a comparison condition, for a defined period in patients with alcohol dependence after completion of detoxification, over 10 sessions (10 days). Twenty patients will be enrolled, assessed, and treated in each group. Three months after discharge from the clinic, abstinence, abstinence following relapse, drinking patterns, and possible drinking episodes will be compared across the different groups. The overall duration of the study (preparation, recruitment, intervention, follow‑up, and analysis) is estimated at 24 months.
conditions: Mental and behavioural disorders due to use of alcohol: Dependence syndrome

interventions.name: We plan a randomized four‑group design with treatment arms consisting of rTMS / APBM –, rTMS + / APBM –, rTMS / APBM +, and rTMS + / APBM + conditions, with rTMS (verum + vs. sham –) combined with CBM (active + vs. sham –). Participants receive APBM ± immediately after five weekly sessions of rTMS ±

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Male individuals with alcohol dependence (n = 80; 20 per study group) will be enrolled if they meet the ICD‑10 criteria for alcohol dependence and have undergone alcohol withdrawal treatment in a qualified detoxification unit (Asklepios Fachklinikum Wiesen). Patients with alcohol use disorder (AUD) have been abstinent for at least one week.
Exclusion criteria:
Exclusion criteria include severe and/or acute other psychiatric, substance use‑related, or somatic disorders, as well as insufficient proficiency in German.
